orchestrator_output.reformulated_query: How to measure length accurately using a metre scale
orchestrator_output.text_narration: Measuring the length of an object correctly using a metre scale is an essential skill in science. To get an accurate measurement every time, we need to follow three important rules. First, place the scale in contact with the object along its entire length. Make sure the scale is strictly parallel to the edge you are measuring, without any slant or tilt. Second, if the zero mark of your scale is worn out or broken, do not start from zero. Instead, start from any other full mark, such as 1 centimetre, and subtract that value from the final reading at the end. Third, your eye must be placed directly above the reading mark. Looking at the scale from the left or right side causes parallax error and leads to wrong measurements.
